Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Note that the section on "Equip Minions" (page 22) keeps talking about
giving your "minions" equipment, which means "vampires and allies".
In theory a non-humanoid ally could get equipment, but as someone else
pointed out, there don't happen to be any that can.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@hal.com Wizards of the Coast, Inc.

Messages.Author: da...@rain.org
Messages.Body:
The Hell Hound cannot equip with anything because he can take NO actions
only block, thus he can neither equip himself or take equipment from
another minion.
